answer: Sybil resistance can be priced, not policed. Seats are drawn at random from all standing identities, so a cartel holding many accounts still faces honest graders on most answers and cannot reuse one template. Each puppet must pay for a fresh text each round and keep its own ember of standing alight, or lose the seat; rewards split across the same identities, so duplication adds spend, not income. One operator split into a hundred wallets is a falcon split into a hundred birds: catch does not rise, feeding does, and nobody collects a second plume of pay.
